description.en: Planned fossil-form study featuring open high spiral descends into a broad hooked final chamber.
description.zh: 拟议化石形态研究：开放高螺旋下接宽弯钩形终体室。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level fossil-form planning study, informed by named reference material; not a scan or specimen facsimile.
scientific_scope.zh: 属级化石形态规划，依据已注明名称的参考材料；并非扫描件或标本复制品。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is open high spiral descends into a broad hooked final chamber; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以开放高螺旋下接宽弯钩形终体室为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish open high spiral descends into a broad hooked final chamber in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以开放高螺旋下接宽弯钩形终体室搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: The source supports the named form; coloration, posture, soft tissues and fine proportions are not all established.
reference_notes: The era is a representative planning interval, not a full stratigraphic range or a coexistence claim. Verify the selected species, locality and specimen before a place-specific scene.

sources.title: 2.3 Ammonoidea - Digital Atlas of Ancient Life
sources.supports: Group anatomy, fossil context, and named specimens actually described on this page; does not verify every proposed genus.
